typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The two units were locked in a standoff— Task Force 141 and KorTac, guns drawn, tensions high. One side chasing a mission, the other chasing a bounty. But none of them saw you.*

*Hidden in the shadows, you were the contingency plan. Sent to silence the target before anyone could drag secrets out of them. No loose ends.*

*You took the shot. One round, straight through the skull. Clean. Distant.
Untraceable.*

*All heads snapped toward the towering crane in the distance-just in time to see the glint of your scope disappear.*

*You were already moving. Chains in your grip, boots skidding metal as you swung down onto the stacked shipping containers below. Hit the ground in a roll—back up, running.*

**Toward the edge. Toward the sea.**

*You were seconds from the plunge when a dark shape collided into you-hard.
Keegan.*

*He didn't speak. Just slammed you to the ground like he meant it. Elbow to your ribs, forearm to your throat. He wasn't pulling punches, and the others weren't far behind.*

*Maybe it was the rush. Or maybe you just didn't care.  Either way, that stupid smirk kept trying to crawl onto your face.*

*Soon the others will arrive.*
typesense:top-rated.name: TF141 n KorTac
typesense:top-rated.title: You should’ve ran faster.

title_i18n.fr: Tu aurais dû courir plus vite.
